desc_en: A secure, multi-channel government messaging platform enabling public service bodies to communicate with citizens across email and SMS.
features: MyGovID integration for login and signup
long_desc:
MessagingIE is an open-source Building Block of the Irish Government's Digital Government platform, designed to give Public Service Bodies (PSBs) a unified, secure, and standards-compliant way to communicate with citizens.
It supports delivery via email, with support for reusable message templates, scheduled notifications, and reminders. PSBs can integrate with MessagingIE through a well-defined API, allowing them to trigger communications programmatically as part of broader service journeys without managing their own notification infrastructure.
MessagingIE is live in production and serves as the successor to the Digital Postbox, consolidating government citizen messaging under a single platform. It is a component of the wider Building Blocks programme, which includes FormsIE, Journey Builder, and a shared User Profile and Dashboard, enabling joined-up digital public services for citizens.
name: Government of Ireland MessagingIE
short_desc: A secure, multi-channel government messaging platform enabling public service bodies to communicate with citizens across email and SMS.
